title: CACTUS: Auditable Evidence Admission for Repository-Level Software Engineering Agent Benchmarks — IST Review Artifact v1.52
description: This archive accompanies the CACTUS Information and Software Technology (IST) manuscript v1.52. The review ZIP regenerates the structured manuscript, value ledger, tables and figures offline from fixed projections and runs synthetic admission-checker regression. Its recorded partial audit reproduced 29 exclusion decisions from original bundles. Complete original-run re-admission and model/evaluator replay require separate access to the retained research archive. The release contains a sanitized review artifact.
